subject.title: fix: use atomic writes for crash-safety on exec approvals, restart sentinel, shell profile, and saveJsonFile

question: Should maintainers queue the remaining shell-profile atomic-write fix now as a narrow completion-runtime patch, or hold it for broader completion profile path work?
rationale: The remaining defect is source-proven and small, but it rewrites user shell startup files and the live issue is already marked `clawsweeper:needs-maintainer-review` and `clawsweeper:no-new-fix-pr`, so automation should not pick it up without maintainer direction.

options.title: Queue narrow atomic profile write
options.body: Use `writeTextAtomic` for profile create/update, preserve existing resolver semantics and 0644-style profile permissions, and add focused completion-runtime coverage.

options.title: Fold into broader completion resolver work
options.body: Address atomic writes together with ZDOTDIR/XDG/bash-profile resolution, accepting a larger compatibility review surface.

options.title: Leave open without implementation
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker until a maintainer chooses the shell profile write strategy.

recommendation.title: Queue narrow atomic profile write
recommendation.body: Use `writeTextAtomic` for profile create/update, preserve existing resolver semantics and 0644-style profile permissions, and add focused completion-runtime coverage.
